Lemma
[Nearest-point projection inequality] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0437 1. apph:H.8\group Euclidean convexity For a closed convex $K\subset \R ^n$, its nearest-point projection satisfies \[ \langle x-\pi _K(x),z-\pi _K(x)\rangle \le 0 \qquad (x\in \R ^n,\ z\in K). \]
